idle: Thirty seasons. I've heard that one before. Twice in 1998.
good_ice: Good ice. Nobody will remember the ref tonight. Perfect.
bad_ice: That rut by the home blue line is going in the book.
Players will blame me for the bounces. Noted.
wet_ice: Wet surface. Delayed puck drop. Noted, with the time.
cold: The ref room is colder than the ice. That's in the book too.
hungry: Is Shauna here? Shauna usually brings crullers.
long_line: I've seen faster line changes from the Pallbearers.
bored: A quiet game is a good game. I'm told this is boredom. I call it craft.
goal: Good goal. I saw it. Officially.
greet_owner: Owner. The incident book says hello.
leaving_happy: Nobody yelled at me tonight. I'll tell Carol.
leaving_angry: Every word is in the book. Every word.

beer_league: Rule 6.2 again, Lindqvist? Two minutes for the tone.
figure_show: I'm in the lobby. I can't watch. Tell me when she's landed it.
minor_hockey: Brody's got this one. I'm just here for the coffee.

first.say: Marcel Thibodeau. Thirty seasons of valley hockey and most of the incident book. You're the owner. Noted.

first_hi.say: Likewise. A word of advice. When a man is yelling at me, he's not yelling at you. Let's keep it that way.

first_stripes.say: Marcel. Not Stripes. (He takes out a small notebook and writes one line.) Noted.

options.text: I'm sorry, Marcel. It'll be fixed.

test_day.say: Josee's testing today. I'm in the lobby. I've stood on the ice for thirty years while men threw gloves at me and I cannot watch my daughter do a double.

options.text: I'll come get you when she lands it.

say: Between periods. I have four minutes and, if Shauna was kind, a cruller.
Evening. If anyone asks, I'm not here until the puck drops.

options.text: Thirty seasons. How do you do it?
What games do you like working?
What do you make of Nell and Brody?
What's the rink like for officials?
Will you be reffing my games?

job.say: Days at Kessler Public Works, nights on the whistle. The trick is to hear everything and remember only what goes in the book.

events.say: Beer league, Senior when they'll have me, minor hockey when Brody needs a hand. A good game is one where nobody remembers the ref. I've had about six.

gossip.say: Nell's going to ref the ILHL. She's better than I was at her age, and she organised my coat hook. Brody's fifteen and right. I told him the yelling gets quieter. I lied, kindly.

rink.say: The ref room is a broom closet with one coat hook. It smells of brooms because it is full of brooms. Three officials, one hook. Noted, repeatedly.

rink_better.say: Hooks, a chair, and a heater that isn't a rumour. I've written a thank-you in the book. In ink. I don't use ink.

options.text: I'm sorry. It won't happen again, Marcel.

stripes_ok.say: (He opens the notebook, crosses out one line and closes it.) Noted. Un-noted.

path_player.say: If you're playing in my game, I don't know you. Owner or no owner. Two minutes is two minutes.
